title: The Space manage panel's /manage/leadership/open prefetch is blocked by connect-src in production, so something on that path redirects off the site's own origin.

source.ref: Found while tracing SCAN-1214 in the production csp.violation log, 2026-11-16 (security thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE.

detail:
EVIDENCE: Vercel runtime logs, event csp.violation, 2026-11-15 21:34 to 2026-11-16 00:21 UTC: directive connect-src, blocked https://frequencylocal.com/spaces/house-of-fates/manage/leadership/open?_rsc=... and ...open?to=editor&_rsc=..., document /spaces/house-of-fates?panel=manage (and /manage). A self-origin URL is only reported when the fetch follows a redirect to another origin.

WHY IT MATTERS: The prefetch fails silently for a manager, and the report-only policy hides what the redirect target is.

FIX DIRECTION: Open the route behind /spaces/[slug]/manage/leadership/open, find where it redirects (likely a hosted-site or site-editor host), and either stop prefetching it (prefetch={false} on the link) or add the host to connect-src.

CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED IN CODE 2026-11-16 (row stays open until the production log is quiet): app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/leadership/open/route.ts is the website admin handoff. By design it mints a signed pass and answers 303 to the Space's own website host (<site host>/admin/enter?to=...&pass=...), so the off-origin target is the Space's website, not an unknown host. The Website builder shortcut in components/spaces/manage-quick-links.tsx (shown on /spaces/<slug>?panel=manage and /manage) pointed a next/link at that route, and next/link prefetches it, so every view of the panel fetched the redirect, minted a pass and tripped connect-src. That link is now a plain same-tab anchor (a handoff flag on the link, pinned by manage-quick-links.test.ts), the same way the Leadership page buttons and the console's Page editor item already link to it. Nothing was added to connect-src. NOT verified: the logged request without a to= parameter was not reproduced; no code builds that address, so it is most likely the same link's route prefetch. To close: after this deploys, confirm the csp.violation log shows no new /manage/leadership/open reports.

verify.evidence: Open: the redirect target of /spaces/<slug>/manage/leadership/open is not yet identified. Close when the link no longer produces a connect-src report in the production csp.violation log.
